# Regression Fixture

`invoice-242.jpg` is the user-supplied generated invoice used for mocked-response schema and validation regression tests. The expected values are test-only and do not appear in production extraction logic. The source invoice collection is attributed in `data/README.md` to *Samples of electronic invoices* (Kozłowski and Weichbroth, 2021), Mendeley Data, CC BY 4.0. Keep this attribution if redistributing the fixture.
